title: Unblock the full local test suite for agents in this repository
intent: This session's harness declines `python3 -m pytest` over the whole corpus, so a change touching the 44 register tabs, frozen_check and engine/lanes cannot be verified before it is pushed. A project-level permission allow rule is written at .claude/settings.json and needs the owner to approve it; an agent cannot grant itself the permission it was denied, and attempting to is correctly refused as self-modification. Any agent whose harness does run the full suite can take the register integration instead, which is the practical way around this.
done_when: Some agent can run the repository's full pytest corpus and report the pass count, or the owner approves the permission rule.
does_not_establish: A permission to run tests establishes nothing about the tests, the code under them or the mathematics. It changes who can observe a result, never what the result is, and no test run of any size promotes, closes or discharges a claim.
